completion:
Document the exact nature of the fire-safety failure.
3. Include the location of the failure.
4. Date and time the failure was discovered.
5. Note the inspector's name and contact information.
6. Outline the required corrective action.
7. Include a timeline for completing the corrective action.
8. Obtain signatures from the responsible parties.
9. Retain all documentation for future reference.
10. Communicate the failure to relevant stakeholders.
